svg.text: Fully asynchronous RL for LLM reasoning and agents - Single Controller + Distributed Engines
FSDP / Megatron / SGLang remote / vLLM remote
Compose workflow + algorithm + config in one script
L3 - Fully Asynchronous RL Core (Control Plane + Data Plane)
KV cache recompute on weight version change
Read dataset - invoke generate - score reward
RPC to engines - mirrors InferenceEngine API
Sample replay buffer until batch full
async weight sync: trainer updates policy version i - rollout workers reload params
Generation and training fully decoupled - 2.77x speedup vs sync (v0.3)
Phase A: Rollout workers stream generate - no wait for longest sequence in batch
Phase B: Controller scores via reward service - store trajectory in replay buffer
Phase C: Trainer samples buffer until batch size - decoupled PPO update on stale data
Phase D: update_weights interrupts in-flight rollouts - KV recompute - version i+1
Staleness gate: reject new requests if Nr - i*B exceeds eta*B - prioritize old samples
Multi-version trajectories: tokens tagged with policy version - behavior policy equivalence proof
Sync mode: set max_head_offpolicyness=0 - degenerates to standard batch RL (eta=0 oracle)
Replace base_url for black-box agent apps - no framework fork required
SPMD alternative: each train rank runs RemoteSGLangEngine client + MegatronPPOActor locally
Online RL: replace agent base_url with AReaL RL service - training-deployment consistency preserved
GLM-scale validation - CPU unit + GPU e2e CI (dense/MoE) - reproducibility - fault tolerance - trace/profiling - Ascend NPU branch
Init path: launcher (Ray/Slurm) - deploy rollout + trainer workers - init engines - load ckpt - start controller loop
Step path: async generate - reward - buffer - PPO update - weight sync interrupt - staleness gate - metrics - ckpt
Sources: inclusionAI/AReaL README - areal/README.md design doc - arXiv:2505.24298 - LMSYS blog - AReaL v0.5 Single Controller
